running_sequence: Wait WINDOW=1; manual suggests 10 ms between polls, at most 1000 polls
classic.sdk_conflict: Several SDK routines set ACCESS before waiting WINDOW; use the own-manual order for this group. Never allow unbounded await/delay under ACCESS.

wait_access.extra: SYSCTRL.CR2.RTCLPM must be zero for synchronized writes.

wait_only.extra: Do not copy L010 ACCESS/WINDOW. Check WAIT between DATE and TIME writes, not only around both as one batch.

coherent_read_boundary: Manuals permit repeated same-register reads until equal; no common hardware full-calendar atomic snapshot register is documented. Backend-specific synchronized transaction plus bounded time/date/time or full-pair retry and decoded-calendar validation is required. Never combine independent SDK GetDate/GetTime calls without a rollover fence; do not stop RTC just to read it. Software coherence and hardware rollover behavior must be separately tested.

verification.generation: ./d gen-all passed once after frozen changes

own_manual_post_correction_table_compari.status: Every physical-page RTC table offset and field span agrees after normalizing only F020 alarm naming aliases.

first_api: now() -> Result<DateTime, Error> with bounded coherent read
set_datetime(&mut self, DateTime) with full validation and WAIT checks
recommendation.supported_starting_scope: Blocking calendar at whole-second resolution, 2000..2099, explicit 24-hour cold-init; preserve/decode an already-running 12-hour calendar without silently changing its mode. HSIOSC operation is run/sleep-limited and not accurate battery-backed time. Prefer independently managed LSE capability for real wall clock.
must_first_resolve: Public RCC exposes HSI only; no published RTC kernel frequency/source lifetime or LSE/LSI ownership API
Clock init currently stops HSI for recalibration; an HSIOSC-sourced preserved RTC can lose ticks before attach
No generic enable_and_reset on RTC; capture boot/reset cause before consumers clear shared reset flags
Provide bounded timeout and cleanup for WAIT/WINDOW; never await while protected access is active
defer: Async alarm/AWT futures until shared IRQ, races, cancellation and low-power oscillator retention tested
Subseconds API until coherent date/time/subsecond snapshot verified
Calibration and RTC output/tamper pins until per-board reference/pin routing qualified
Backup-register API or independent VBAT claims, unsupported by register inventories
